newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN SAYS BOARD PRICE RISES DELAYED.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN SAYS BOARD PRICE RISES DELAYED.

text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman said on Tuesday its advertised price rises for carton board, sacks and corrugated board would be delayed.

"Price hikes for carton board, sacks and corrugated board will come a bit later than expected," AssiDoman chief executive Lennart Ahlgren told a news conference held in connection with the group's six-month earnings.
Even so, Ahlgren said he expected to raise carton board prices by four to five percent on October 1 and sack prices this autumn.
"In a low-inflation economy it will be difficult to implement price hikes for highly processed goods. We must become more efficient and cut costs."
On the other hand, price rises on sack paper and kraft paper could come somewhat earlier than expected, Ahlgren said.
AssiDoman posted a profit after financial items of 859 million crowns, slightly higher than market forecasts of 819 million crowns.
The bank reported a profit of 1.23 billion crowns for the first half of 1996.
